text:
nina_ops: Hi team - I just got married overseas and need to add my spouse to Redwood health + dental. Marriage certificate is from Spain. What's the fastest way to enroll and is retro coverage possible to our wedding date (2025-03-22)?

sam_hr: Congrats, Nina! For QLE due to marriage you have 30 days from the event to enroll for prospective coverage; carriers sometimes allow retro enrollment back to the date of marriage for special circumstances but it's not guaranteed. We'll need the marriage certificate (certified translation if not in English), spouse's DOB, SSN (or last 4), and passport or national ID.

nina_ops: Translation - do you accept an embassy notarized translation or does it need a certified translator?

sam_hr: Embassy notarized translation or certified translator are acceptable. Please include a copy of the Spanish certificate and the English translation as separate files.

ben_benefits: Upload route: Workday > Benefits > Manage Dependents > Add Dependent > Upload Documents. If you don't see the option, reply here and we'll open an intake case. For SSN we will request full SSN via a secure intake link; last 4 is okay for initial intake but carriers need full SSN to finalize enrollment.

nina_ops: I'm concerned about timing - I'm traveling back next week and need proof of coverage for an upcoming appointment. Can we expedite?

ben_benefits: We can request expedited processing from the carrier but we need completed intake first. If you email benefits@redwood.com with subject "Expedite spouse enrollment - nina_ops - marriage 2025-03-22" and attach the docs we will prioritize and flag to the carrier. Include a short note on the appointment date and why expedited coverage is needed.

sam_hr: Also confirm if spouse is currently covered elsewhere (COBRA or employer plan). If yes, carriers sometimes require termination or COBRA documentation for coordination of benefits. If spouse had a dependent-only plan, still include that info.

nina_ops: Spouse is not employed right now, no other coverage. Spouse is a Spanish citizen with passport. I have scans of passport + marriage certificate + translation. Any naming normalization required? His passport uses two surnames.

ben_benefits: Please upload documents with filenames like: passport_lastname-firstname.pdf and marriage_certificate_translation.pdf to avoid confusion. In the enrollment form put the spouse's legal name exactly as on passport. We can add alias fields if needed.

people-ops-bot: Intake ticket created: #HR-84712. Benefits specialist assigned: ben_benefits. Expected response within 1 business day.

nina_ops: If the carrier denies retro coverage, when would coverage start if processed now?

sam_hr: Typically the carrier effective date for QLE enrollments processed within the window is the date of the event or the first of the month following processing, depending on carrier rules. Common outcomes: retro to event date, or effective 1st of next month. Dental/vision sometimes have different effective rules. We'll confirm carrier-specific effective date once intake is complete.

ben_benefits: Also FYI: to add HSA contributions you may need to update payroll elections. After enrollment is finalized we will send a confirmation and a form for benefits/pretax elections.

nina_ops: Sending docs via secure upload now. Thanks all!
